scope: Independent read-only review of source-native Discards reconciliation and focused GE/TE EE-floor-ON A/B evidence. No solver execution, mapping change or adoption.
required_preservation_and_checks: Use the same completed-before-floor audited snapshot and pinned current-engine bytes for A and B; retain source, canonical, archived loader, current engine and runner hashes separately.

Preserve living biomass, P/Q, predation, consumption, respiration, egestion, catch, living BA/migration, diets, group IDs and detritus fate. Only the explicit documented fishery return differs between A and B.
Verify every native fleet donor/destination and name against canonical/runtime IDs. Native destination 36 is Detritus, not the group named Discards 35; do not route by the word discards alone.

Persist pre-injection/pre-floor, post-return/pre-floor and post-floor states. Apply floor once after the exact initialization. Require equivalent floor eligibility, per-group sink and total sink when living inputs are unchanged.

Keep source native BA=0 distinct from legacy loader-derived closure and current post-floor residuals. Negative Discards BA is neither observed accumulation nor an evidenced import. Do not zero it silently in A/B.

Separate fishery mortality/total-catch weights from internal returned material. B keeps the same catch vector and fishery PPR weights while physical budgets credit each return once. Return is neither external mortality export nor a new basal source.
Recompute recipient inflow deltas, exact native donor return totals, detritus residual deltas, internal return credits and unchanged catch totals directly from saved arrays, without running a solver.

Inspect full lossless GE/TE matrices with all 37 recipient groups, exact source columns and masks. Check negative and nonfinite entries before rounding, including unfished groups; reconcile all/inner/PP scopes and catch-weighted footprints.

Distinguish overall WARN/FAIL, input budget status, strict method balance and component grades. Arithmetic closure or absence of negative source entries does not resolve source-native Discards support.

A current-engine no-return baseline may differ from earlier saved floor results because engine logic changed. Report such differences with explicit code/state identities rather than attributing them to the return treatment.
